title: Physical consistency contracts for radiomics software integration
design: Synthetic software verification study with development and locked held-out inputs; not clinical validation or external independent validation
trust_boundary: A trusted source frame and declared transformation are compared with the decoded image and mask at a NIfTI file boundary. Internal extractor states are not observed.

domain.image: Real finite 3D arrays, orthogonal nonsingular voxel axes, explicit millimetre NIfTI spatial units, consistent qform/sform when both are present
domain.mask: Matching array shape, finite int16 labels, nonempty selected positive label; paired affine agreement is checked separately
domain.mirp_intensity: Selected ROI intensities must be nonnegative; MR context with fixed-bin-size25 and lower anchor0, no voxels removed in the synthetic study
domain.source_geometry: XYZ array axes; affine maps voxel centres to RAS millimetres

development.purpose: Implementation, domain and numerical tolerance checks before any held-out outcome
development.configuration_correction: The initial CT context in MIRP rounded fractional intensities by design. The final MR context retains the positive fractional input values. No feature tolerance was relaxed.
development.independent_core_tests: Signed permutations checked against a separately implemented voxel-to-physical-coordinate oracle and SimpleITK reader

heldout.no_redraw: Retain every attempted seed and fault, including inactive faults, boundary errors, extraction failures and zero scalar drift

decisions.witness: Independent direct indexing i=Bj on the full grid; corresponding decoded intensities and selected ROI booleans; affine physical positions at all eight grid corners
decisions.scalar_laws: Versioned native feature keys; scalar equivalence excludes axis-labelled diameters; spatial powers and positive affine intensity laws only where explicitly assigned
decisions.applicability: Independent source mean, variance, voxel count and full ROI coordinate rank guard weighted-centre, autocorrelation and ellipsoid-density relations; changed extraction settings abstain from the full-vector relation
decisions.feature_schema: The complete pinned output key set must be present; a missing key cannot become a pass by being absent in both outputs
decisions.abstention: Not applicable is never counted as satisfied

comparators: Usable native extraction completion, preserving warnings
Nominal paired image-mask shape and affine agreement
Repeated extraction of the same corrupted input
Feature-only relation to the clean reference
Full witness plus applicable feature laws and anchors
Unconditional full-vector invariance on legitimate physical changes and changed-bin controls

analysis.primary_unit: One phantom and fault family; 512 attempted held-out fault instances per engine, grouped by eight mechanisms
descriptive_values: median and range of I/O plus witness time and native extraction time
analysis.inference: No hypothesis tests or pooled feature-level confidence intervals; transformations, engines and repeated feature values are dependent observations
analysis.runtime: Single native thread per worker; process-level workers recorded per run; preparation timing includes writing, reading and witness rather than witness-only latency
